content: लुण्ट् I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (लुण्टति) .²1 To go. .²2 To steal, rob, plunder. .²3 To be lame or crippled. .²4 To be idle or lazy. --II. €1 <ab>P.</ab>, €10 <ab>U.</ab> (लुण्टयति-ते) .²1 To rob, plunder, steal; कटकं लुण्टयामास स कृष्णो भास्करात्मजः <ls>Parṇāl. 5. 106</ls>. .²2 To disregard, despise.
